description: This file contains functions related to retrieving and processing MAC addresses from various system sources in an OpenWrt-based environment. It includes functions to read MAC addresses from device tree, JSON configuration, MTD partitions, MMC devices, and encrypted blobs, as well as utilities for MAC address manipulation.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a specified device or file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from /etc/board.json configuration.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the MAC address label from device tree, falling back to JSON config.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device for an MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from a partition part.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address in ASCII format from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address stored in an encrypted MTD partition for Arcadyan devices.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts MAC address stored in an encrypted MTD partition for Deco devices.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from UCI config in UBI volumes.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address from a specific offset in an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns the size of an MTD partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address in ASCII format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Retrieves binary MAC address data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC portion of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats a MAC address into EUI format with separators.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'locally administered' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts various MAC address formats into canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled (okay).
